## Section: curriculum
```yml
heading: Workshop Agenda
items:
  - title: "Day 1: Foundations of Dose Calculations"
    subtitle: Understanding the Basics with Confidence
    points: |
      - Units & conversions (mg, g, mcg, mL, IU)
      - Common formulas explained simply
      - Ratio & proportion made easy
      - Rounding rules & medication safety
      - Common calculation errors in practice
      - "Interactive: Live quizzes on Kahoot"
      - "Interactive: “Spot the mistake” activities"
      - "Interactive: Case studies"
      - "Outcome: Participants confidently perform basic dose calculations"
  - title: "Day 2: Weight-Based, Age-Based & OTC Dosing"
    subtitle: Real-World Dosing for Adults & Children
    points: |
      - mg/kg dosing step by step
      - Pediatric dosing & safe dose limits
      - Syrups, suspensions & drops
      - Maximum dose vs calculated dose
      - "OTC: Paracetamol & ibuprofen"
      - "OTC: Antihistamines"
      - "OTC: Vitamins & supplements"
      - "OTC: Counseling on OTC dose safety"
      - "Interactive: Case scenarios (adult & pediatric)"
      - "Interactive: Parent-counseling role play"
      - "Interactive: Group decision-making: safe vs unsafe doses"
      - "Outcome: Participants calculate, evaluate, and counsel safely"
  - title: "Day 3: Clinical & Hospital-Based Calculations"
    subtitle: Applying Calculations in Practice
    points: |
      - IV dose calculations
      - Infusion rates (mL/hr, mg/hr)
      - Dilutions & concentrations
      - Percentage solutions
      - Emergency & crash cart calculations (intro level)
      - "OTC–Clinical Safety Bridge: OTC overdose risks"
      - "OTC–Clinical Safety Bridge: Polypharmacy considerations"
      - "OTC–Clinical Safety Bridge: Documentation & double-check practices"
      - "Interactive: Simulated medication charts"
      - "Interactive: Time-pressured clinical scenarios"
      - "Interactive: Group discussion on real errors & prevention"
      - "Outcome: Participants apply calculations safely in clinical settings"
  - title: "Day 4: Case-Based Mastery & Patient Safety"
    subtitle: "Confidence, Safety & Real-Life Judgment"
    points: |
      - Dose adjustment scenarios
      - Special populations (elderly, renal, pediatrics)
      - Medication error prevention strategies
      - Safe documentation & communication
      - "Final activity: Mini OSCE-style stations"
      - "Final activity: Team challenge: “Calculate & Defend Your Dose”"
      - "Final activity: Pre- vs post-assessment comparison"
      - "Final activity: Reflection & key takeaways"
      - "Outcome: Participants leave confident, competent, and safety-focused"
```
